uncited: It builds on [Implicit methods (SDF-based)](12421-implicit-methods-sdf-based.md) by specifying the functional form (SDF) and common parameterization strategies.
**Inputs:** 3D coordinates $\mathbf{x} \in \mathbb{R}^3$; learnable parameters $\theta$ (weights and biases of the network or grid values).
The SDF function $f$ is parameterized by $\theta$.
**Dense Grid:** A 3D volume $G_\theta$ with resolution $R_H \times R_W \times R_D$.
**Query:** For a given 3D point $\mathbf{x}$, retrieve or compute the SDF value $s$.
For grids, these are the values in $G_\theta$.
*   **When to use:** When explicit, clean geometry is required.
